single-line high-contrast Song; light lead plus warm pale highlighted name

firstVisualFocus: oversized upper-left two-tone Song headline, then central face
primaryMechanism: full-bleed believable environment plus centered guide figure; long upper translucent band and short right mid band stage a left-to-right headline staircase
dominantAxis: human center near x52%; typography advances upper-left to mid-right
negativeSpace: relatively quiet sides of person below y43
unfilled clothing and environment zone y43–90
layerOrder: title and subtitle lettering plus short soft shadow
restored front hair and shoulder occlusion
imageTextRelationship: guide/name text points to the visible person; action/outcome text is set beside them; real place or publisher anchors the scene

locked: wide upper and shorter right-mid translucent band
single-line left-upper hero and single-line right-mid support with 2.1–2.4 height ratio
adaptive: headline and support wording within one-line boxes
exact palette and band opacity preserving luminance structure
optional: minor soft shadow tuning for changing photo contrast

variableContract.person: identity, clothes, pose details may change while a single centered identifiable guide stays around x26–75%, y21–100%, with face near x53%, y32%
variableContract.text: words may change; preserve semantic two-color single-line upper title, smaller single-line right result, small spaced bottom source
variableContract.product: clothes, bag, tool or visible item may change but remain naturally part of person or truthful scene; no floating sticker product
variableContract.palette: specific hues may change while dark real-scene majority, medium-light neutral translucent bands, pale lettering, and localized garment color remain

effects: thin translucent bands with visible scene

transformationGrammar.action: recrop or extend real environment while preserving person and bottom bleed
locally darken or lower background contrast; retain truthful scene detail

transformationGrammar.trigger: hair or shoulder cannot overlap strips from flat image
transformationGrammar.action: isolate same-source foreground contour and restore above strips with edge repair

transformationGrammar.trigger: person and setting are unrelated or identity cues absent
transformationGrammar.action: obtain suitable truthful human-in-setting asset before test

preferred: real person guide in a retail or working setting
expert or founder viewpoint anchored in real place

palette.areaCaveat: photograph, strips and lettering overlap; areas are not additive

typography.hero: 4–6 Han characters in one line; thick vertical/thin horizontal Song skeleton, pointed serif termini, stable baseline, tight non-touching spacing
typography.support: 5–7 Han characters in one line; same family at roughly 42–48% hero character height, slightly more tracking
typography.source: small clean Han, spaced roughly 1–1.5 glyph widths; no decorative serif treatment
typography.effect: semantically split neighboring pale colors and short soft lower-right shadow; no thick outline or extrusion

failureModes: font skeleton drifts to generic Song or blackface
bottom source competes as third title
